title: The Jubilee Clemency
logline: A dockworker holding an unpayable station mortgage races to deposit his debt slate before the midnight bell of a decennial jubilee festival, hunted by collectors cutting the power.

roles.description: An aging environmental technician whose habitat lease has doubled every year under compound collection penalties.
Presides over the ceremonial debt-burning urn at the central civic dais; strict on protocol, but weary of lender lawsuits.
Represents the private factoring firm that bought the worker's mortgage; methodical, polite, monitoring the countdown clock.
The private debt enforcement syndicate holding delinquent orbital habitat liens across the sector.
The decorated central concourse where citizens gather beneath lanterns to burn certified debt contracts.
A dark lower-deck maintenance bay where station mechanics store their emergency equipment and personal safes.

public_situation: The decennial Jubilee chimes ring across {system}, where custom dictates all debts presented at {role:jubilee_plaza} before midnight are legally void.
private_truth: {role:collection_factor} tripped the lower-deck substation breaker to seal {role:indebted_mechanic} inside his shop until the midnight deadline expires.

beats.public_change: Festival bells begin their eight-hour sequence while transit tram power suddenly fails across the lower industrial decks.

missions.reason: He needs an independent pilot to dock at his dark berth and extract his sealed debt ledger slate through the emergency manual airlock.
missions.private_fact: His debt originated from medical oxygen charges he accrued while nursing three apprentice fitters through an air scrubber fire.

beats.public_change: The collection consortium posts legal notices declaring all un-stamped ledgers will default to compound interest at midnight.

missions.reason: He needs portable battery cells rushed to the plaza approach gate to power the mechanical elevator before the midnight chimes finish.
missions.private_fact: {role:collection_factor} offered the elevator guard a quarterly bonus to pretend the hydraulic pump suffered a mechanical breakdown.

beats.public_change: The crowd packs the ceremonial dais while {role:collection_factor} waits beside the bailiff holding foreclosure warrants.

missions.reason: He needs the verified mortgage slate carried directly into the ceremonial burning urn before the twelfth toll of the solstice gong.
missions.private_fact: {role:collection_factor} is authorized to settle out of court for fifty percent cash if the slate reaches the dais before the strike.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot stands at the ceremonial dais as the final chimes echo. Three people demand the slate.

options.label: Toss the slate into the ceremonial urn to incinerate the debt
Sell the slate to the collection factor for a cash buyout
Demand the bailiff impound the slate for an official tampering inquiry

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot deposits the slate into the ceremonial fire before midnight.
resolutions.summary: The mortgage slate burns to ash before the crowd. {role:indebted_mechanic}'s home is declared free, and {role:recovery_consortium} takes a total loss.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot sprinted through festival crowds to drop an old mechanic's mortgage into the jubilee flames just as midnight chimed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the slate to the collection factor for private scrip.
resolutions.summary: {role:collection_factor} secures the slate before midnight. The mechanic's workshop is seized, and the factored loan is converted into lifelong servitude.

consequences.public_summary: Word circulated that a runner sold an honest mechanic's jubilee slate to the bailiff's collectors on the steps of the square.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot hands the slate to the bailiff citing sabotaged station power.
resolutions.summary: {role:jubilee_bailiff} freezes the foreclosure pending an inquiry into the deliberate power outage, leaving both the worker and lender tied up in legal limbo.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the delivery runs or abandons the contract before midnight.
resolutions.summary: Midnight tolls across the darkened lower decks. Without a registered presentation, the debt default clause takes effect and the workshop is padlocked.

loose_threads.detail: The main circuit breaker for the tram route shows chemical burn marks from an industrial cutting torch applied thirty minutes before sundown.
The debt ledger lists the mechanic's mortgage bundle bundled into an investment trust holding seventy percent of the station's life support bonds.
The jubilee registry at {role:jubilee_plaza} lists two identical cancellation logbooks signed by different clerks in the same handwriting.

radio_hooks: Crowds assemble at {role:jubilee_plaza} for the traditional lighting of the cancellation brazier.
Power outages reported across lower industrial decks; municipal engineers cite 'grid strain'.
{role:recovery_consortium} urges citizens to resolve outstanding liens before midnight.

voice_direction.indebted_mechanic: Trembling, hoarse, and breathless from climbing unpowered ladders. Speaks with the desperate rhythm of a gambler watching their last stake on the table.
voice_direction.jubilee_bailiff: Dry, formal, and bureaucratic. Delivers ancient liturgical legal phrasing with total indifference, checking his pocket timepiece every thirty seconds.
voice_direction.collection_factor: Silky, unbothered, and relentlessly cheerful. Speaks of financial ruin with warm corporate friendliness, never dropping his polished customer service cadence.
